parent: Actual 6cd59fb M115 clean-reps Git release tree (163 files) as the M56 parent: the milestone that added the rep count and the three docs corrections. It already stores the trader’s plan (M102 versions included) and displays it; what it does not do is read it on the decision path, which is exactly the row. This milestone adds one FILE and no schema object.

feature.scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks, saved rows, HTTP and a real DOM only. The trader’s OWN written plan (strategies.entry_rules, stored as a list of lines and edited in the Playbook) read as a gate on the signal: a `require` line the engine can check is evaluated against facts the analysis already computed, a line that fails refuses the candidate through the ordinary no_trade/veto path with the trader’s own sentence first, and a line the app cannot check is reported as unverifiable rather than shown as satisfied. NO new schema object, no backfill, no write on a read. No broker, provider, mental-state, pixel or production proof, and NO performance claim: the gate is boolean and the payload says it influences no grade, score, cap or price. RAW failures/early aborts and DECLARED assumptions stay separate. DECLARED NEGATIVE carried here by name: the inherited M99/M101 reviews cohort is STALE at this HEAD — 157/3 against its committed 159/1, because the schema grew after M101; the three gaps are declared, not repaired in the probe.

regression_parents.method: Actual 9c88e0a M12 Git release as the M13/M65 parent (the milestone these periods sit on), plus the M112 cohort’s and the inherited reviews cohort’s own measured parent maps, inherited unchanged — no parent is re-derived here and no schema or module is read out of an older runner.

controls.parent_tree: the committed 6cd59fb M115 release: no module, no payload gate, no reader route, and the three views/docs untouched — five probes 0/1 each, the mode-aware control 17/0
controls.gate_only_tree: the parent plus `src/bots/plan-gate.js` alone: the vocabulary, the parse and the per-direction evaluation can be computed and are measured working (pure 43/0, migration 21/0) while the engine, the API payload, the screen and the alert surface know nothing about them (engine 2/1, api 2/2, ui 1/1, control 16/1 on the alert row)
controls.why: The staged fault is a missing READING around a working module, not a missing rule: that is why the pure and migration arms pass on the gate-only tree while the engine, api and ui arms fail on the absence the milestone closes.

gate.all_or_nothing: every machine-checkable `require` line is evaluated per direction and any failing line refuses the candidate through the ordinary no_trade/veto path, unshifted so the plan sentence leads `action`, the verdict, the Now strip, Copy plan and the log button
gate.prose_never_parsed: non-`require` lines are reported as unverifiable and `exit_rules` / `checklist` / `market_conditions` stay displayed context: polarity cannot be read from free text
gate.unknown_refuses_nothing: a fact the app could not read is `unknown`; an unreadable PLAN is `unavailable` and refuses everything; no active plan blocks nothing
gate.unrecognised_is_loud: a `require` line outside the vocabulary is surfaced with its reason in the payload and on the screen, never passed silently
gate.no_influence: boolean gate only: no grade, score, cap or price is moved (measured), `broker_verified:false`, and the payload publishes the limits
gate.storage: read from the existing `strategies` rows and the M102 version rows; no table, no column, no index, no trigger, no backfill, and a read writes nothing

doc_corrections.API: docs/API.md gains the `GET /bots/plan-gate` row (states, per-line classification, limits) and `strategy_id` on analyse/chart/scan, with the scan row noting `plan_gate` + `plan_refused`
doc_corrections.PLAYLIST-CURRICULUM row 16: the Trading-plan row no longer reads as "Playbook view + guardrails": it now names the gate, the module, the all-or-nothing reading, the refusal shape, and the limits stated in the editor (only the listed lines are enforced; prose is never interpreted; an unrecognised `require` line is reported loudly)
doc_corrections.NOT-IMPLEMENTED: a new "written plan as a gate" row in §3 names what works AND what is missing (prose is never parsed, `exit_rules`/`checklist`/`market_conditions` are not enforced, and the gate refuses SIGNALS rather than grading a logged trade), and §5 item 5 now says so in the sentence that claims a plan-vs-execution grade is still missing

scope: M56 the written plan as a gate: one read-only module (`src/bots/plan-gate.js`, plan-gate-v1), the three payload routes reading the trader’s own plan (analyse, chart, scan), a reader route that publishes the vocabulary and the classification, and two views that make the refusal and the enforced lines visible. Explicitly NOT claimed: prose understanding, a performance or expectancy claim, a grade/score/cap/price influence, broker verification, a plan-vs-execution grade, a pixel proof, or anything about a real account.
